name: find-reasoning-for-task
description: Find successful prior OpenWiki execution traces whose task or outcome resembles the current task, including ordered actions and tool outcomes.

config.template: CALL db.index.fulltext.queryNodes('reasoning_memory_search', $query, {limit: $limit}) YIELD node AS trace, score WHERE trace.success = true OPTIONAL MATCH (trace)-[:HAS_STEP]->(step:ReasoningStep) OPTIONAL MATCH (step)-[:USES_TOOL]->(call:ToolCall) WITH trace, score, step, call ORDER BY score DESC, step.step_number ASC WITH trace, score, step, collect(CASE WHEN call IS NULL THEN null ELSE {tool: call.tool_name, status: call.status, duration_ms: call.duration_ms, arguments: call.arguments, result: call.result, error: call.error} END) AS raw_calls ORDER BY score DESC, step.step_number ASC WITH trace, score, collect(CASE WHEN step IS NULL THEN null ELSE {step_number: step.step_number, thought: step.thought, action: step.action, observation: step.observation, tool_calls: [item IN raw_calls WHERE item IS NOT NULL]} END) AS raw_steps RETURN trace.id AS trace_id, trace.task AS task, trace.outcome AS outcome, score, [item IN raw_steps WHERE item IS NOT NULL][0..20] AS steps ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT $limit

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Keywords describing the current OpenWiki task.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of successful traces to return; use 5 unless the caller asks otherwise.

name: recent-reasoning-traces
description: Return the most recent OpenWiki reasoning traces and their ordered execution steps for recency-based fallback memory.

config.template: MATCH (trace:ReasoningTrace) WHERE $success_only = false OR trace.success = true WITH trace ORDER BY trace.started_at DESC LIMIT $limit OPTIONAL MATCH (trace)-[:HAS_STEP]->(step:ReasoningStep) OPTIONAL MATCH (step)-[:USES_TOOL]->(call:ToolCall) WITH trace, step, call ORDER BY trace.started_at DESC, step.step_number ASC WITH trace, step, collect(CASE WHEN call IS NULL THEN null ELSE {tool: call.tool_name, status: call.status, duration_ms: call.duration_ms, error: call.error} END) AS raw_calls ORDER BY trace.started_at DESC, step.step_number ASC WITH trace, collect(CASE WHEN step IS NULL THEN null ELSE {step_number: step.step_number, thought: step.thought, action: step.action, observation: step.observation, tool_calls: [item IN raw_calls WHERE item IS NOT NULL]} END) AS raw_steps RETURN trace.id AS trace_id, trace.task AS task, trace.outcome AS outcome, trace.success AS success, trace.started_at AS started_at, [item IN raw_steps WHERE item IS NOT NULL][0..20] AS steps ORDER BY started_at DESC

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of traces to return; use 5 unless the caller asks otherwise.

parameters.name: success_only
parameters.description: True to return only successful traces.

name: openwiki-tool-reliability
description: Rank OpenWiki tools by observed call volume, success rate, failures, and latency.

config.template: MATCH (tool:Tool) RETURN tool.name AS tool, tool.total_calls AS total_calls, tool.successful_calls AS successful_calls, tool.failed_calls AS failed_calls, CASE WHEN tool.total_calls = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE toFloat(tool.successful_calls) / tool.total_calls END AS success_rate, CASE WHEN tool.total_calls = 0 THEN null ELSE toFloat(tool.total_duration_ms) / tool.total_calls END AS avg_duration_ms, tool.last_used_at AS last_used_at ORDER BY total_calls DESC LIMIT $limit

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of tool statistics rows to return; use 10 unless the caller asks otherwise.
